metadata.llm_reason: Scale Instance Cloning and Threshold Scale Cloning are semantically identical capabilities—both clone scale objects via .copy() to create independent copies preserving configuration. They differ only in scale type (ordinal vs. threshold) but share the same method_family (object_cloning), task_family (scale_management), and workflow pattern. The candidate should merge into the existing threshold scale cloning skill, which can be generalized to cover all scale types, or the threshold skill should be deprecated in favor of a unified scale cloning skill. Peer candidate Threshold Scale Cloning already exists and is more recently staged (execution vs. post_configuration).
